claims.text: The FDA doravirine label lists carbamazepine among anticonvulsants that lower doravirine concentrations and says co-administration is contraindicated.
claims.quote: Anticonvulsants carbamazepine oxcarbazepine phenobarbital phenytoin ↓ doravirine Co-administration is contraindicated with these anticonvulsants.

headline.text: The FDA doravirine label lists co-administration with carbamazepine as contraindicated, with lower doravirine concentrations (c1).

reported.text: The doravirine label shows carbamazepine decreasing doravirine concentration and contraindicates co-administration.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
